title: Membership in a tribe frequency part
statement: Let $w,s$ be natural numbers, let $T$ be a set of indices among the $sw$ positions, let $i$ be a block index among $s$ blocks, and let $o$ be a position among $w$ positions. Then $o$ belongs to the frequency part of $T$ for block $i$ if and only if the position corresponding to the pair $(i,o)$ belongs to $T$.
